title: The owner changes priority from the item page
description: A signed-in operator opens the item from its Work row, changes P3 to P0 and then to P2 on the item page, with attributed audit reasons. Existing P4 is retained. Authenticated operator, maintainer and master calls succeed; worker and viewer calls fail. The next one-worker dispatch selects the later-created promoted item without changing gates or forcing a claim.
